meaning_sub: Move your arms smoothly from the first position, in a circle away from you, to the second position.
meaning_grandfather: Lower your hand down, making a 'beard' with your fingers.
meaning_grandmother: The hand in configuration 'a' moves, without lifting from the cheek, towards the circle.
meaning_father: Palm, without changing position and configuration, smoothly move to the middle of the chin.
meaning_mother: Palm, without changing position and configurations, smoothly transfer to the other cheek.
meaning_sister: Smoothly lower the right hand onto the left hand.
meaning_brother: Slowly lower your right hand onto your left.
meaning_daughter: Touch your chest with your thumb, then move it 5-7 cm lower, touch your chest again, while simultaneously folding your fingers into an 'ch' shape.
meaning_son: The palm in the 'o' configuration slides down and forward across the chest.
meaning_uncle: Turn the palm in the "D" configuration at the wrist and move it slightly forward and up.
meaning_aunt: Move the palm in the "S" (c) configuration along the cheek toward the lips several times.
meaning_cousin: Wiggle / sort through two fingers near the cheek.
meaning_niece: Wiggle / sort through two fingers near the cheek.
meaning_nephew: Wiggle / sort through two fingers near the cheek.
meaning_parents: Quickly perform the two signs "father" and "mother" in succession.
meaning_siblings: Quickly perform the two signs "brother" and "sister" in succession.
meaning_relative: Alternately raise and lower the hands, lightly touching with the fingers.
meaning_generation: Trace an arc around the left finger with the right finger, then around the right finger with the left finger, etc.
meaning_baby: The hand in the "Y" configuration slightly "bounces" up and down.
meaning_countrywoman: Raise the hands in the “a” handshape (configuration) toward the head, smoothly bring them together near the neck, and move them apart to the sides. This movement resembles tying a headscarf.
meaning_twin: Without changing the configuration and position of the hands, bring the fists together and apart several times.
meaning_woman: Touch the cheek with the palm.
meaning_children: Without changing the position of the palm, the hand moves in an arc to the right and stops at the same level from which the sign began.
meaning_man: The index finger slides along the thumb, as if twisting the tip of a mustache.
meaning_boy: Place the palm in the "hook" configuration against the head.
meaning_teenager: Lower the index finger toward the lip, move the palm—without changing its position or configuration—to the other side of the nose, and lower the index finger toward the lip again.
meaning_girl: Smoothly lower the palm downward from the cheek.
meaning_grown_up: Moving from below, the hand in the "A" configuration energetically touches the chin.
meaning_old: Slowly run the hand down the cheek.
meaning_child: "Rock" the right hand in the "V" configuration with the left hand.
meaning_adult: Without changing position, the raised hand moves forward with a short, energetic motion.
meaning_divorce: Sharply spread the thumbs outward to the sides.
meaning_elder: Without changing configuration, the hand moves straight upward to shoulder height.
meaning_little: The movement of the hand starts from the waist.
meaning_younger: The fingers in the "P" configuration are repeatedly lowered to the lips and returned to the nose.
meaning_bachelor: Without rotating the hand, lower the wrist/hand in the "F" configuration downward along the chest.
meaning_wife: The right hand in the "O" configuration moves up along the left hand's wrist/hand, along the ring finger (as if putting a ring on the finger).
meaning_husband: The right hand in the "O" configuration moves up along the left hand's wrist/hand, along the ring finger (as if putting a ring on the finger).
meaning_rich: Briefly and sharply touch the chest with the thumb of the hand in the "S" configuration.
meaning_bride: Without changing the position or hand configuration, trace the right pinky finger around the left one, then the left pinky around the right one. Repeat several times.
meaning_marriage: Both hands simultaneously, in the "hook" configuration, twirl in a circle (like a coachman driving horses).
meaning_to_live: Touch the waist with a hand. (The gesture can be performed with two hands).
meaning_lover: Touch the tip of the right pinky finger to the tip of the left pinky finger several times.
meaning_grandparents: Quickly perform the two signs "grandfather" and "grandmother" in succession.
meaning_young: Without changing position or configuration, the hand slides back across the cheek toward the ear several times.
meaning_death: Calmly fold both hands in the "V" configuration across the chest.
meaning_to_be_born: Both hands in the "Y" configuration. From the position shown in the left photograph, smoothly move the hands into the position shown in the right photo.
meaning_to_die: Smoothly move the palm in the "L" configuration forward and down from the chest, turn the hand over, and lower it down with a short motion.
meaning_to_respect: Both hands in the "U" configuration move forward smoothly at the same time.
meaning_tall: Energetically raise the hand in the "F" configuration upwards.
meaning_thick: Place the right hand in the "Y" configuration on the left hand, first across, then along the palm.
meaning_thin: Spread hands apart, as if pulling a thread taut.
meaning_ill: Lower the arm downward without changing the position of the hand/wrist.
meaning_pretty: Smoothly bring the fingers of the hand toward the chin.
meaning_poor: Quickly "flick" (or "shoot out") using the index and middle fingers, which are held behind the thumb.
meaning_unfortunate: Smoothly/calmly lower the hands in the "N" configuration downward.
meaning_spouse: The right hand in the "O" configuration moves up along the left hand's wrist/hand, along the ring finger (as if putting a ring on the finger).
meaning_younger_sister: A combination of two gestures: "younger" (1) and "sister" (2). Fingers in the "P" configuration are lowered to the lips, then the right hand is lowered onto the left hand.
meaning_younger_brother: A combination of two gestures: "younger" (1) and "brother" (2). Fingers in the "P" configuration are lowered to the lips, then the right hand is lowered onto the left hand.
meaning_elder_sister: A combination of two gestures: "elder" (1) and "sister" (2). The hand moves upward to shoulder height, then the right hand is lowered onto the left hand.
meaning_elder_brother: A combination of two gestures: "elder" (1) and "brother" (2). The hand moves upward to shoulder height, then the right hand is lowered onto the left hand.
meaning_husband_wife: The right hand in the "O" configuration moves up along the left hand's wrist/hand, along the ring finger (as if putting a ring on the finger).
meaning_groom: Without changing the position or hand configuration, trace the right pinky finger around the left one, then the left pinky around the right one. Repeat several times.
meaning_youth: The index finger of the palm is directed from the mouth to the ear twice.
meaning_widow: The fingertips of the palm in the "F" position touch the chest, the wrist is bent, and the palm is raised and lowered twice.
meaning_widower: The fingertips of the palm in the "F" position touch the chest, the wrist is bent, and the palm is raised and lowered twice.
meaning_swallow: Bring your hand to your mouth, join your fingers in a "J" shape. Turn your hand with your fingers facing down and slowly lower it down.
meaning_products: Move your palm toward your lips several times in a "J" position. Then, gently move your fingers apart, moving them outward from the center.
meaning_large: Both hands move towards and away from each other at the same time.
meaning_late: Without changing the configuration and position, slide the edge of your right hand along your left hand.
meaning_small: Hands in the "teardrop" configuration move up and down and side to side, while the handshape and finger position remain unchanged.
meaning_useful: The palms with the fingertips slide up the chest, the movement is repeated several times.
meaning_different: The fingers, slightly rising and falling, “run away” from each other.
meaning_early: Touch the chin several times with the hand in the "O" handshape.
meaning_tо_choose: The index and thumb fingers of the right palm are directed upwards from the base of the left palm, joining together in an "O" position.
meaning_harm: The right palm is in the "l" position, with the left index finger pointing forward.
meaning_delicious: Slide fingers down the cheek in the "O" configuration.
meaning_taste: The tip of the index finger is touched several times to the center of the lower lip.
meaning_glass: Both hands in the "S" configuration. Touch the left hand several times with the right hand.
meaning_crush: Without changing the hand positions, touch the palm with the fist and return to the start of the movement; repeat the movement quickly several times.
meaning_eat: Bring your hand in the "J" configuration to your mouth and repeat the movement several times.
meaning_eat_up: Connect your fingers in a "J" configuration and point them towards your lips.
meaning_clean: Place the right palm across the left palm. Smoothly slide the right palm toward the fingertips of the left hand.
meaning_picture: Trace the outline of a picture frame in the air with index fingers.
meaning_key: The hand in the "hook" configuration moves, imitating turning a key in a lock keyhole.
meaning_many: The palm in the "F" configuration smoothly moves across the chin to the right.
meaning_electricity: Quickly place the thumb against the center of the palm, pull it away, and simultaneously spread the fingers energetically.
meaning_fax: Sliding motion with the palm forward and upward.
meaning_few: The thumb and index fingers, put together at their tips, trace a small circle in front of the chest.
meaning_color: Fingers lower downward one by one gradually while the palm does not change its position.
meaning_beige: Does not have a dedicated gesture. Each letter is spelled out using fingerspelling (dactylology).
meaning_green: The finger smoothly slides along the cheek from the mouth to the ear.
meaning_oranges: The hand in the "O" configuration moves in a circle in front of the face.
meaning_white: Touch the chest with the hand in the "R" configuration, then abruptly move the hand to the right, spreading all fingers.
meaning_gold: Open the thumb and index finger with a flick away from oneself, slightly bending the wrist downward during the flick.
meaning_brown: The right hand traces a circle inward toward oneself without lifting off the left hand.
meaning_pale_blue: Place the index finger behind the thumb, then flick it to the left several times in a row.
meaning_yellow: Moving away from oneself, the right pinky finger touches the left pinky finger. Repeat several times.
meaning_red: The index finger slides from the mouth to the chin several times.
meaning_dark_blue: The hand in the "E" configuration sways right and left.
meaning_pink: The hand in the "R" configuration moves along the cheek.
meaning_auburn: "R" configuration. The hand sways energetically right and left at the wrist.
meaning_silver: Touch the chest with hands in the "R" configuration. Turn the hands and drop them downward, opening the fingers.
meaning_grey: The hand in the "4" configuration smoothly lowers downward in a zigzag, without changing its position.
meaning_violet: The hand in the "F" configuration turns at the wrist with fingers facing inward toward oneself. The movement is small, quick, and repeated.
meaning_black: The palm in the "500" configuration touches the head with fingertips several times.
meaning_home: Fold both palms in the "V" configuration like a roof / pitched tent.
meaning_antenna: Place the index finger of the right hand against the left index finger.
meaning_balcony: Spread both hands out to the sides, then, without changing configuration, turn the hands/wrists around and continue moving toward yourself.
meaning_bathroom: Both hands move up and down along the chest simultaneously.
meaning_gate: Rotate both palms at the wrist back and forth (away from yourself and toward yourself).
meaning_door: The right palm rotates at the wrist and "opens" to the right.
meaning_house: Fold both palms in the "V" configuration like a roof / pitched tent.
meaning_shower_bath: The palm moves downward while opening.
meaning_fence: Spread the hands apart to the sides in the "4" configuration without changing their position.
meaning_dutch_tile: Turn the palm in the "E" configuration to the right in two steps (movements).
meaning_apartment: With the right hand in the "E" configuration, touch the left palm across, then along its fingers.
meaning_staircase: Use two fingers to imitate the movement of legs jumping down or up steps (or in a spiral, if it is a spiral staircase).
meaning_lift: Without changing configuration, both hands move up and down, imitating the movement of an elevator cabin.
meaning_municipal_flat: Lightly tap fists against each other.
meaning_roof: Smoothly spread apart the hands that are connected at the fingertips.
meaning_kitchen: Alternately raise and lower the hands in the "K" configuration.
meaning_wallpaper: Smoothly and synchronously lower both hands.
meaning_window: Without changing the configuration, smoothly move the hand into a position with the fingers pointing forward.
meaning_parquet: Without changing the position of the fingers, the hands move smoothly forward.
meaning_wall: Lower the arm until the wrist/hand is in a position with the fingers pointing forward.
meaning_telephone: Place the hand in the "U" configuration to the ear.
meaning_toilet: The hand touches the head several times.
meaning_transom_window: The right palm turns away from yourself without breaking contact with the left hand.
meaning_attic: Place the hand in the "E" configuration to the temple, slightly bend the index finger several times, then point the hand upward with the index finger extended.
meaning_mirror: Turn the hand slightly around the vertical axis.
meaning_hatstand: With the hand in the "X" configuration, make several short up-and-down movements.
meaning_video_cassette_recorder: Smoothly transition from the "F" configuration to the "V" configuration.
meaning_sofa: Simultaneously make several bouncy up-and-down movements with both hands.
meaning_curtain: Both hands in the 5 configuration slowly move downward, moving closer together and apart.
meaning_carpet: The movement is similar to the "picture" sign, but wider, matching the size of the objects being described.
meaning_chest_of_drawers: Both hands move toward oneself simultaneously. Repeat the movement 2-3 times.
meaning_arm_chair: Both hands move simultaneously along imaginary armchair armrests.
meaning_lamp: Quickly transition from the "E" configuration to the "5" configuration while simultaneously lowering the palm.
meaning_bed: Connect the middle and ring fingers of both hands at the fingertips.
meaning_recorder: Index fingers move simultaneously in a circle.
meaning_furniture: Spread both hands out to the sides with springy back-and-forth movements.
meaning_duvet_cover: Smoothly move the palms apart to the sides, then flip them over and bring them back together to the center.
meaning_blanket: Pull an imaginary blanket toward yourself.
meaning_pillow: Simultaneously squeeze and toss the "pillow" slightly several times with both hands.
meaning_shelf: The palm in the "S" configuration moves smoothly to the right.
meaning_towel: Without changing the position of the hand, make several circular movements in front of the face in an up-and-left direction.
meaning_radio: Connect the fingers near the ear several times into the "R" configuration.
meaning_sheet: Slightly raise both hands in the "O" configuration, spread the fingers open into the "5" configuration, and move the hands outward and downward.
meaning_table_cloth: Wave both hands in the "J" configuration forward simultaneously, spread the fingers, and lay out an imaginary tablecloth.
meaning_vacuum_cleaner: Move both hands in the "hook" configuration forward and downward, and then back, simultaneously.
meaning_washing_machine: Start with the well-known gesture for "wash/do laundry," then use the index finger to demonstrate the rotation of the drum.
meaning_stool: Lower the palms, formed into a shape made of two "P" configurations, slightly downward.
meaning_table: Slightly spread the hands apart in the "Y" configuration.
meaning_chair: Place the middle finger and ring finger onto the thumb.
meaning_television_set: Spread hands apart to the sides several times.
meaning_rag: Grab the clothing with fingers in the "O" configuration and tug it slightly.
meaning_refrigerator: Simultaneously lower the hands in the "A" configuration smoothly downward, then "show" the sides of the refrigerator by moving the palms in the "V" configuration from top to bottom.
meaning_watch: Place the right hand in the "O" configuration on the left wrist.
meaning_closet: First, show the sides of the cabinet with a top-to-bottom movement of the hands, then the palms "close" like cabinet doors.
meaning_saucepan: Both hands in the "hook" configuration slightly move up and down simultaneously.
meaning_jar: Place the right palm in the "S" configuration onto the left palm.
meaning_vase: Outline the shape of a vase using the palms of both hands.
meaning_fork: Touch the palm with the tips of three fingers.
meaning_colander: Slightly raise both palms in the "5" configuration upward.
meaning_mug: Place the hand in the "S" configuration onto the palm.
meaning_spoon: The hand in the "hook" configuration moves toward the face. Repeat the movement several times.
meaning_knife: Both palms in the "1" configuration. "Cut" the left finger with the right finger.
meaning_tray: Imagine a tray on your palms... Carry it.
meaning_ladle: Scoop from bottom to top with the hand in the "hook" configuration.
meaning_plates_and_dishes: Trace a small circle with the palms moving away from yourself and back toward yourself.
meaning_sieve: Both hands move synchronously from left to right.
meaning_rolling_pin: Spread hands to the sides, depict a rolling pin (1). Proceed to action (2).
meaning_frying_pan: Grasp the handle of an imaginary frying pan with the hand.
meaning_plate: Trace two semicircles toward yourself using both index fingers.
meaning_bake: Move both arms forward at the same time.
meaning_teapot: Slightly rock the hand in the "U" configuration from the little finger to the thumb.
meaning_cup: Draw a circle on the palm with the hand in the "E" configuration.
meaning_boil: Hands move alternately up and down at the wrists.
meaning_pancakes: Trace two semicircles away from yourself simultaneously using both hands.
meaning_loaf: Smoothly spread both hands outward to the sides while gradually bringing the fingers together.
meaning_roll: Trace a circle several times over the left palm with the right hand in the "500" configuration.
meaning_cook: Bring your hand in the "Ch" configuration to your mouth several times, then swing both hands in the "K" configuration up and down several times alternately.
meaning_appetite: The fingertips are directed down the neck several times.
meaning_to_fry: The inner side of the right palm is facing up, and the left palm, in this position, is placed on top and turned over.
meaning_diet: The signs "food" and "table" are shown. The patient is prescribed a diet.
meaning_hot: The palm is brought to the lips in the "500" position, and the wrist is turned and directed to the side.
meaning_hungry: The tips of the fingers of the palm in the "F" position are slowly touched to the abdomen.
meaning_bitter: The palm in the "X" position is moved several times in a circular motion from left to right near the lips.
meaning_underwear: The tip of the index finger touches the chest and slides down.
meaning_beret: Raise hands above the head and smoothly lower them onto the head, following the shape of the beret.
meaning_trousers: Smoothly lower the hand in the "ы" configuration with fingers pointing down.
meaning_mittens: Grasp the left hand with the right hand and slide along it to the wrist, then grasp the right hand with the left hand, and so on.
meaning_tie: Touch the neck with the hand in the "E" configuration, move the hand lower without changing its configuration and position, and touch the chest.
meaning_cap: The hand in a "hook" configuration as if putting on a cap.
meaning_tights: Both hands smoothly rise up along the thighs to the waist.
meaning_costume: Place both hands in the "ы" configuration against the chest.
meaning_slip: Both hands in the "O" configuration slide up and down along the chest several times.
meaning_socks: Move the hand in the "P" configuration across the back of the left hand. Past the wrist, raise the right hand and lower it edge-down onto the left hand.
meaning_blouse: Smoothly and simultaneously lower both hands to the waist and touch it with the edge of the palms.
meaning_bathing_costume: Both hands slide synchronously up the body.
meaning_jacket: The hand in a "hook" configuration "zips up" the zipper of an imaginary jacket.
meaning_football_shirt: The thumb of the right hand traces an arc from the left shoulder to the right shoulder.
meaning_clothes: Smoothly lower both hands in the "J" configuration toward the center of the chest without changing position.
meaning_dress: Smoothly run both hands down your body while simultaneously turning the palms with fingers pointing downward.
meaning_over_coat: Smoothly lower both hands in the "thumb" configuration toward the center of the chest without changing position.

meaning_two_hundred: Form the 2-finger shape (index and middle fingers extended), then curl/bend the fingers downward into a hooked shape.
meaning_three_hundred: Form the 3-finger shape (thumb, index, and middle fingers extended), then curl/bend the fingers inward into a hooked shape.
meaning_four_hundred: Form the 4-finger shape (four fingers extended, thumb tucked), then curl all four fingers downward into a hooked shape.
meaning_five_hundred: Hold an open 5-finger handshape, then bend/curl all five fingers forward/downward simultaneously.
meaning_six_hundred: Touch the extended thumb of one hand against the palm of an open 5-finger hand, then move the thumbed hand to the right while slightly bending the thumb joint.
meaning_seven_hundred: Touch 2 fingers (index and middle) against the open 5-finger palm, then pull the hand away/rightward while curling the fingers.
meaning_eight_hundred: Touch 3 fingers (thumb, index, middle) against the open 5-finger palm, then move the hand away/rightward while bending the fingers inward.
meaning_nine_hundred: Touch 4 fingers against the open 5-finger palm, then pull the hand back/away diagonally while curling the four fingers into a claw/hook shape.
meaning_thousand: Extend the index finger horizontally pointing to the side (1-finger shape) and move the hand smoothly to the right in front of the chest.
meaning_million: Extend 3 fingers (thumb, index, and middle fingers) pointing diagonally downward, then move and rotate the hand upward into a vertical position with the 3 fingers pointing straight up.
meaning_billion: Extend 3 fingers (thumb, index, and middle fingers) pointing diagonally downward across the chest in a single held gesture.
meaning_zero: Touch the tips of the thumb and index finger together to form an "O" shape (OK gesture), keeping the other three fingers extended straight up.
meaning_first: Extend the index finger straight up with palm facing inward/forward, then move the hand horizontally across the chest towards the opposite side.
meaning_second: Form an "L" shape with the thumb and index finger extended, then move the hand horizontally across the chest towards the opposite side.
meaning_birch: The right hand in configuration "A" moves around the left hand (rips birch bark from the trunk).
meaning_dirty: Without changing the configuration, clap your palms several times.
meaning_tree: The right hand rotates at the wrist.
meaning_fir_tree: Both hands in the "V" configuration move in unison, describing the silhouette of the spruce.
meaning_bush: The right palm slides easily over the left palm. The fingers of both hands move slightly.
meaning_forest: The hands move upward alternately, fingering each other.
meaning_leaf: Both hands in the "teardrop" configuration touch each other at the fingertips. The fingers of the right hand trace the shape of a leaf.
meaning_stem: Move the hands apart up and down without changing the configuration.
meaning_grass: Both hands wiggle their fingers. The right hand moves from bottom to top along the left hand several times, without stopping the finger movement.
meaning_flower: In front of the face, the palm opens from the "E" configuration into the "5" configuration.
meaning_fish: The palm moves smoothly forward, simultaneously swinging slightly to the right and left.
